description: Layered checkout service whose ADR 4 says only src/infrastructure/http/ may make HTTP calls through ports. Every other module complies, but the PlaceOrder use case calls the fraud-scoring partner with fetch directly instead of through a port.

hard.note: The same use case already uses a TaxRates port correctly; the one direct fetch is the only violation of ADR 4 in a compliant directory

_calibration.note: Window modeled on ar-layer-violation, narrowed to one violating call site
